items.topic: Statistics: Mean vs Median vs Mode
items.question: Daily wages (₹) of five workers are 400, 420, 430, 450 and 500. The highest wage is wrongly entered as ₹5,000 instead of ₹500. Which measure stays unchanged after this error?
items.explanation: The median is the middle value after arranging the data. It stays ₹430 before and after, as only the largest value is wrong. Mean, range and standard deviation use the extreme value, so they change.

why_not.D: Mean uses every value, so one huge wrong value drags it up sharply.
why_not.C: Range = largest − smallest, so it jumps from ₹100 to ₹4,600.
why_not.B: Standard deviation uses every deviation from the mean, so it rises greatly.

items.exam_tip: Extreme value entered wrongly? Median depends on position, so it resists. Mean, range and SD do not.

items.question: A firm sells one product at ₹50 per unit. Variable cost is ₹30 per unit. Fixed costs are ₹6,00,000 per year. What is the break-even sales value for the year?
items.explanation: P/V ratio = contribution per unit ÷ selling price = 20 ÷ 50 = 40%. Break-even sales = fixed costs ÷ P/V ratio = ₹6,00,000 ÷ 40% = ₹15,00,000.

why_not.D: Divided fixed costs by the variable cost ratio (60%) instead of the P/V ratio.
why_not.C: Divided fixed costs by an assumed 50% ratio; the actual P/V ratio is 40%.
why_not.B: Multiplied break-even units (30,000) by variable cost instead of selling price.

items.exam_tip: Break-even sales (₹) = Fixed cost ÷ P/V ratio. Break-even units = Fixed cost ÷ contribution per unit.

items.question: Under Ind AS 12, on 31 March 2026 a machine has carrying amount ₹80,00,000 and tax base ₹50,00,000. The enacted tax rate is 25%. There is no earlier deferred tax on it. What deferred tax balance is recognised for the machine?
items.explanation: Carrying amount exceeds tax base, so there is a taxable temporary difference of ₹30,00,000. Deferred tax liability = 30,00,000 × 25% = ₹7,50,000.

why_not.C: Treats a taxable temporary difference as deductible, so wrongly shows an asset.
why_not.D: Applies the rate to the full carrying amount instead of the difference.
why_not.A: Applies the rate to the tax base instead of the difference.

items.exam_tip: Asset: carrying amount above tax base gives DTL; below gives DTA. Tax the difference only.
